summary:
Atlassian is the company behind Jira and Confluence, at atlassian.com. This page is that corporate host’s icon, not a Jira project avatar.

Checked 12 November 2026 against atlassian.com. HTML came from https://www.atlassian.com/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.atlassian.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15086 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.atlassian.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #2288ff comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 4757 bytes) from https://www.atlassian.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
